messages.author: Elin Bergström
messages.text: Monday AM is the protected quarter-close freeze on both tier-1 approvers — board-protected, not movable without Declan. Diego holds grid-dispatch; config plus dispatch is a segregation-of-duties conflict, refuse it.

messages.author: Ben Carter
messages.text: I have Thursday 2026-05-14 free both windows. The standard says the review is one continuous session, so no splitting it across days.

messages.author: Owen Pryce
messages.text: Thursday works if that is the earliest that fits cleanly. Note the rest for me.
